snippet.title: Legion | Expansion Trailer
snippet.description:
Purpose is power in the Legion expansion, coming on 27 May, and the power is in your hands! Make your mark through Freelance Jobs that connect you to the legendary players that have made EVE Online what it is today, and to those that that are creating the New Eden of tomorrow. Fly as legion, under one banner, commanding devastating new warships that redefine battlefield power and leverage new sovereignty upgrades to strategically customize your space for maximum control, and more.   

Learn more about Legion at: https://www.eveonline.com/news/view/legion-expansion-launches-on-27-may

Start playing EVE for free today: http://EVE.Online/Fly_Now
Get the latest EVE News: https://www.eveonline.com/news
